CHARGING THE LIBRARIES: 

```{r libraries}

library(tidyverse) 
library(ggpubr)    
library(multcomp) 
library(car)
library(emmeans)

```

PREPARING THE DATASETS:  

```{r data}

#### MAIN DATASETS

# data on nearest and chosen shelter types
stack = read.csv("DATA/pro/stack.csv", sep = ";", header = TRUE)

# data on FID, size, distance from shelter
FID_vsm_data = read.csv("DATA/pro/FID_vsm_data.csv", sep = ";", header = TRUE)

# data on size and chosen shelter type
refuge_df = read.csv("DATA/pro/refuge_df.csv", sep = ";", header = TRUE)

# data on human population density
people_df = read.csv("DATA/pro/people.csv", sep = ";", header = TRUE)

#### TRANSFORMING FID AND DISTANCE FROM NEAREST SHELTER DATA TO LN(X + 1)

FID_vsm_data$logFID <- log(FID_vsm_data$FIDi + 1)
FID_vsm_data$logDist <- log(FID_vsm_data$d_fr_refug + 1)


#### SUBSETS OF FID_vsm_data FOR EACH COUPLE SITE-SEASON

# High disturbance - dry season 
slydry <- FID_vsm_data %>% 
  filter(season == 'dry') %>% 
  filter(site == 'Salaya')

# High disturbance - wet season 
slywet <- FID_vsm_data %>% 
  filter(season == 'wet') %>% 
  filter(site == 'Salaya')

# Low disturbance - dry season 
ptmdry <- FID_vsm_data %>% 
  filter(season == 'dry') %>% 
  filter(site == 'Phutthamonthon')

# Low disturbance - wet season 
ptmwet <- FID_vsm_data %>% 
  filter(season == 'wet') %>% 
  filter(site == 'Phutthamonthon')
```

MAIN MANUSCRIPT:

### Methods 

##### Estimation of human population density 

```{r human population density }

# High disturbance - dry season 
slydryppl <- people_df %>% 
  filter(site == 'salaya')%>% 
  filter(season == 'dry')

mean(slydryppl$people_1min) # 23.7
min(slydryppl$people_1min) # 0 
max(slydryppl$people_1min) # 150
sd(slydryppl$people_1min) # 34.8
median(slydryppl$people_1min) # 9 

# High disturbance - wet season 
slywetppl <- people_df %>% 
  filter(site == 'salaya')%>% 
  filter(season == 'rainy')

mean(slywetppl$people_1min) # 18.1
min(slywetppl$people_1min) # 0
max(slywetppl$people_1min) # 89
sd(slywetppl$people_1min) # 22.1
median(slywetppl$people_1min) # 11 

# Low disturbance - dry season 
ptmdryppl <- people_df %>% 
  filter(site == 'phutthamonthon')%>% 
  filter(season == 'dry')

mean(ptmdryppl$people_1min) # 2.3
min(ptmdryppl$people_1min) # 0 
max(ptmdryppl$people_1min) # 10
sd(ptmdryppl$people_1min) # 2.8
median(ptmdryppl$people_1min) # 2 

# Low disturbance - wet season 
ptmwetppl <- people_df %>% 
  filter(site == 'phutthamonthon')%>% 
  filter(season == 'rainy')

mean(ptmwetppl$people_1min) # 1
min(ptmwetppl$people_1min) # 0 
max(ptmwetppl$people_1min) # 29 
sd(ptmwetppl$people_1min) # 3.9
median(ptmwetppl$people_1min) # 0 

```

### Results 

##### Comparisons of FID between sites and seasons

Basic descriptors
```{r min max mean median sd for each site-season}

# High disturbance campus  - dry season 
min(slydry$logFID) # 0
max(slydry$logFID) # 3
mean(slydry$logFID) # 1.3
sd(slydry$logFID) # 0.7
median(slydry$logFID) # 1.3

# High disturbance campus  - wet season 
min(slywet$logFID) # 0.4
max(slywet$logFID) # 2.5
mean(slywet$logFID) # 1
sd(slywet$logFID) # 0.6
median(slywet$logFID) # 0.7

# Low disturbance park  - dry season 
min(ptmdry$logFID) # 0
max(ptmdry$logFID) # 3.2
mean(ptmdry$logFID) # 2
sd(ptmdry$logFID) # 0.6
median(ptmdry$logFID) # 2.1

# Low disturbance park  - wet season 
min(ptmwet$logFID) # 0.4
max(ptmwet$logFID) # 2.4
mean(ptmwet$logFID) # 0.8
sd(ptmwet$logFID) # 0.5
median(ptmwet$logFID) # 0.7

```

Table 2: Statistical summary of the general linear model for Flight Initiation Distance (FID; ln-transformed) as a response variable, site (i.e., high disturbance and low disturbance) and season (dry and wet) as a categorical predictor variables, and the interaction term between site and season
```{r Table 2: FID VS site * season}

mod_fid <- lm(logFID ~ site*season, data = FID_vsm_data)
summary(mod_fid)

Anova(mod_fid, type = 3)

emm <- emmeans(mod_fid, ~ site * season)

pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey")

emmeans(mod_fid, pairwise ~ site | season,
        adjust = "tukey")

par(mfrow = c(2,2))
plot(mod_fid)

```
Figure 3: Box-and-whisker plot showing ln-transformed FID across sites — high disturbance (orange) and low disturbance (green) — and seasons — wet vs. dry
```{r fig 3: FID vs sites and seasons}

fig_3 = ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data= FID_vsm_data, aes(x = season, y = logFID, fill = site), 
               width = 0.7, linewidth = 0.7, outlier.size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "ln(Flight Initiation Distance + 1) (m)", 
       fill = "Site" ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 17),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )  +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'Set2', labels = c("\nLow disturbance \n(Park)\n", "\nHigh disturbance \n(Campus)\n"))+
  scale_x_discrete(label = c("Dry", "Wet")) 

fig_3

```

##### Effects of size classes on FID

Table 3 Statistical summary of the general linear models for Flight Initiation Distance (FID; ln-transformed) as a function of size class (i.e., small, medium, and large), fitted separately for each site–season combination

```{r Table 3: models FID vs size for each couple site-season}

# High disturbance - dry season 
mod_size_slydry <- lm(logFID ~ size, data = slydry)
summary(mod_size_slydry)

# High disturbance - wet season 
mod_size_slywet <- lm(logFID ~ size, data = slywet)
summary(mod_size_slywet)

# Low disturbance - dry season 
mod_size_ptmdry <- lm(logFID ~ size, data = ptmdry)
summary(mod_size_ptmdry)

# Low disturbance - wet season 
mod_size_ptmwet <- lm(logFID ~ size, data = ptmwet)
summary(mod_size_ptmwet)

emm_size_slydry <- emmeans(mod_size_slydry, ~ size)
emm_size_slywet <- emmeans(mod_size_slywet, ~ size)
emm_size_ptmdry <- emmeans(mod_size_ptmdry, ~ size)
emm_size_ptmwet <- emmeans(mod_size_ptmwet, ~ size)

pairs(emm_size_slydry, adjust = "tukey")
pairs(emm_size_ptmwet, adjust = "tukey")
pairs(emm_size_ptmdry, adjust = "tukey")
pairs(emm_size_ptmwet, adjust = "tukey")

```

Fig. 4 Box-and-whisker plot of ln-transformed Flight Initiation Distance (FID) compared across size classes (small, medium and large). Data are grouped by site (high disturbance and low disturbance) and season (dry and wet)

```{r fig 4: FID vs size for each couple site-season}

FID_vsm_data$size <- factor(
  FID_vsm_data$size,
  levels = c("S", "M", "L")
)

labels_dist = c("Low disturbance", "High disturbance")
names(labels_dist) <- c("Phutthamonthon", "Salaya")

labels_seas = c("Dry", "Wet")
names(labels_seas) <- c("dry", "wet")

fig_4 = ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data= FID_vsm_data, aes(x = size, y = logFID, fill = size), 
               width = 0.7, linewidth = 1, outlier.size = 2) +
  facet_grid(season ~ site, labeller = labeller(.cols =  labels_dist, .rows = labels_seas)) +
  labs(
    x = "Site",
    y = "ln(Flight Initiation Distance + 1) (m)",
    fill = "Size"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10), 
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom') +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'OrRd',
                    labels = c("Small", "Medium", "Large"))
fig_4
```

##### Effects of the nearest shelter on FID

Fisher’s Exact Tests: effect of size class on shelter selection
```{r size vs shelter behavior for each size and site-season couple}

# High disturbance - dry season 
salaya_dry <- refuge_df %>% 
  filter(site == 'Mahidol') %>% 
  filter(season == 'dry')

tab <- xtabs(C ~ size + type, data = salaya_dry)
chisq.test(tab)
fisher.test(tab)

# High disturbance - wet season 
salaya_wet <- refuge_df %>% 
  filter(site == 'Mahidol') %>% 
  filter(season == 'wet')

tab <- xtabs(C ~ size + type, data = salaya_wet)
chisq.test(tab)
fisher.test(tab)


# Low disturbance - dry season 
Phutthamonthon_dry <- refuge_df %>% 
  filter(site == 'Phutthamonthon') %>% 
  filter(season == 'dry')

tab <- xtabs(C ~ size + type, data = Phutthamonthon_dry)
chisq.test(tab)
fisher.test(tab)

# Low disturbance - wet season 
Phutthamonthon_wet <- refuge_df %>% 
  filter(site == 'Phutthamonthon') %>% 
  filter(season == 'wet')

tab <- xtabs(C ~ size + type, data = Phutthamonthon_wet)
chisq.test(tab)
fisher.test(tab)

```

Fig. 5 Summary of refuge selection by water monitors. a) Stacked bar chart showing the frequency of the nearest available refuge type by site and season; b) Stacked bar chart showing the frequency of the actual refuge type used during escape; and c) Proportional stacked bar chart illustrating the percentage of escape responses across size classes, faceted by site and season. Colours represent refuge categories
```{r Fig 5: Shelter use }

####  Fig 5.a and 5.b 
stack_N <- stack %>%
  filter(type != "distance")

labels_dist = c("Park", "Campus")
names(labels_dist) <- c("PTM", "MU")

N <- ggplot(transform(stack,
      site=factor(site,levels=c("PTM","MU"))), aes(x = season, y = N, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = 'black') +
  facet_wrap( ~ site, labeller = labeller(.cols =  labels_dist)) +
  labs(
    x = "Season",
    y = "Number of observations",
    fill = "Refuge type"
  ) +
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'BrBG', labels=c('Building', 'Bush', 'Distance', 'Tree', 'Water'))+
  scale_x_discrete(label = c("Dry", "Wet"))

C <- ggplot(transform(stack,
      site=factor(site,levels=c("PTM","MU"))), aes(x = season, y = C, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = 'black') +
  facet_wrap(~ site, labeller = labeller(.cols =  labels_dist)) +
  labs(
    x = "Season",
    y = "Number of observations",
    fill = "Refuge type"
  ) +
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'BrBG', labels=c('Building', 'Bush', 'Distance', 'Tree', 'Water'))+
  scale_x_discrete(label = c("Dry", "Wet"))

ggarrange(N, C, labels = 'auto')

### Fig 5.C 
refuge_df$size <- factor(
  refuge_df$size,
  levels = c("S", "M", "L")
)

labels_dist = c("Low disturbance (Park)", "High disturbance (Campus)")
names(labels_dist) <- c("Phutthamonthon", "Mahidol")

labels_seas = c("Dry", "Wet")
names(labels_seas) <- c("dry", "wet")

refuge_size <- ggplot(transform(refuge_df,
      site=factor(site,levels=c("Phutthamonthon","Mahidol"))),
       aes(x = size,
           y = C,
           fill = type)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", colour = 'black') +
  facet_grid(season ~ site, labeller = labeller(.cols =  labels_dist, .rows = labels_seas)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "BrBG", labels=c('Building', 'Bush', 'Distance', 'Tree', 'Water')) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Size class",
    y = "Proportion of escape responses",
    fill = "Refuge type"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )
refuge_size

### Full figure
NC = ggarrange(N, C, labels = 'auto', legend = "none")

refuge_size = ggarrange(refuge_size, labels = 'c')

fig_5 = ggarrange(NC, refuge_size, nrow = 2)

fig_5

```

Fig. 6 Relationships between Flight Initiation Distance (FID; ln-transformed) and Distance to the nearest shelter (ln-transformed) by site—i.e., high disturbance (orange) and low disturbance (green)—and season (dry and wet). Fitted line indicates predicted value and shading represents 95% confidence interval of the general linear model presented in Table 4
```{r Fig 6: FID vs Distance to shelter for each couple site season}

# High disturbance - dry season 
plot_slydry <- ggplot(data = slydry, aes(x = logDist, y = logFID))+
  theme_bw() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", colour = 'grey6', fill = 'grey', alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, shape = 21, size = 2, fill = '#FC8D62') +
  labs(title = "High disturbance – Dry season",
       x = NULL, 
       y = NULL) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10))

plot_slydry

# High disturbance - wet season 
plot_slywet <- ggplot(data = slywet, aes(x = logDist, y = logFID))+
  theme_bw() +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, shape = 21, size = 2, fill = '#FC8D62') +
  labs(title = "High disturbance – Wet season",
       x = NULL, 
       y = NULL)  +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10)) 
plot_slywet

# Low disturbance - dry season 
plot_ptmwet <- ggplot(data = ptmwet, aes(x = logDist, y = logFID))+
  theme_bw() +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, shape = 21, size = 2, fill = '#66C2A5') +
  labs(title = "Low disturbance – Wet season",
       x = NULL, 
       y = NULL) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10)) 
plot_ptmwet

# Low disturbance - wet season 
plot_ptmdry <- ggplot(data = ptmdry, aes(x = logDist, y = logFID))+
  theme_bw() +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, shape = 21, size = 2, fill = '#66C2A5') +
  labs(title = "Low disturbance – Dry season",
       x = NULL, 
       y = NULL) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10))
plot_ptmdry

fig <- ggarrange(plot_ptmdry, plot_slydry, plot_ptmwet, plot_slywet, 
                 ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
                 labels = 'auto')
  
fig_6 = annotate_figure(
  fig,
  top = text_grob("", size = 1),
  left = text_grob("ln(Flight Initiation Distance + 1) (m)", rot = 90),
  bottom = text_grob("ln(Distance to nearest shelter + 1) (m)")
)

fig_6
```

### ONLINE MATERIALS:

Online Resource 1: Distribution of the Pearson residuals of the general linear model for Flight Initiation Distance (FID) as a response variable, site (i.e., Mahidol and Phutthamonthon) and season (dry and wet) as a categorical predictor variables, and the interaction term between site and season. Left panel represents the distribution of the residuals when using the raw data for FID in the model, right panel represents said distribution when natural log-transforming the data. 
```{r Online Resource 1: histogram residuals: FID vs site * season}

##### raw data

# model
mod_fid_raw <- lm(FIDi ~ site*season, data = FID_vsm_data)

# residuals
mod_fid_raw.res <- residuals(mod_fid_raw)

# plot
p_mod_fid_raw = ggplot()
p_mod_fid_raw = p_mod_fid_raw + ylab ("Frequency")
p_mod_fid_raw = p_mod_fid_raw + xlab ("Pearson residuals")
p_mod_fid_raw = p_mod_fid_raw + theme (panel.background = element_blank())
p_mod_fid_raw = p_mod_fid_raw + theme (panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 1))
p_mod_fid_raw = p_mod_fid_raw + theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill="white", color ="white", linewidth = 1))
p_mod_fid_raw = p_mod_fid_raw + theme(text = element_text(size = 15))
p_mod_fid_raw = p_mod_fid_raw + geom_histogram(colour = "black", fill = "white", data = FID_vsm_data, aes(mod_fid_raw.res), bins = 12) 
p_mod_fid_raw = p_mod_fid_raw +   labs(title = "Raw data", x = NULL, y = NULL)

p_mod_fid_raw  

##### with natural log + 1 transformation
# residuals
mod_fid.res <- residuals(mod_fid)

# plot
p_mod_fid = ggplot()
p_mod_fid = p_mod_fid +ylab ("Frequency")
p_mod_fid = p_mod_fid + xlab ("Pearson residuals")
p_mod_fid = p_mod_fid + theme (panel.background = element_blank())
p_mod_fid = p_mod_fid + theme (panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 1))
p_mod_fid = p_mod_fid + theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill="white", color ="white", linewidth = 1))
p_mod_fid = p_mod_fid + theme(text = element_text(size = 15))
p_mod_fid = p_mod_fid + geom_histogram(colour = "black", fill = "white", data = FID_vsm_data, aes(mod_fid.res), bins = 12)
p_mod_fid  
p_mod_fid = p_mod_fid +   labs(title = "Ln-transformed data", x = NULL, y = NULL)

OR1_res_site = ggarrange(p_mod_fid_raw, p_mod_fid)

OR1_res_site = annotate_figure(
  OR1_res_site,
  top = text_grob("", size = 1),
  left = text_grob("Frequency", rot = 90),
  bottom = text_grob("Pearson residuals")
)
OR1_res_site
```

Online Resource 4 Box-and-whisker plot showing FID across sites—high disturbance (orange) and low disturbance (green)—and seasons—wet vs. dry
```{r Online Resource 4: FID vs sites and seasons (RAW DATA)}

OR4_raw_season = ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data= FID_vsm_data, aes(x = season, y = FIDi, fill = site), 
               width = 0.7, linewidth = 0.7, outlier.size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Flight Initiation Distance (m)", 
       fill = "Site" ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 17),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )  +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'Set2', labels = c("\nLow disturbance \n(Park)\n", "\nHigh disturbance \n(Campus)\n"))+
  scale_x_discrete(label = c("Dry", "Wet")) 

OR4_raw_season
```

Online Resource 5 Box-and-whisker plot of the Flight Initiation Distance (FID) compared across size classes (small, medium and large). Data are grouped by site (high disturbance and low disturbance) and season (dry and wet)
```{r Online Resource 5: FID vs size for each couple site-season (data RAW)}

FID_vsm_data$size <- factor(
  FID_vsm_data$size,
  levels = c("S", "M", "L")
)

labels_dist = c("Low disturbance", "High disturbance")
names(labels_dist) <- c("Phutthamonthon", "Salaya")

labels_seas = c("Dry", "Wet")
names(labels_seas) <- c("dry", "wet")

OR5_raw_size = ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data= FID_vsm_data, aes(x = size, y = FIDi, fill = size), 
               width = 0.7, linewidth = 1, outlier.size = 2) +
  facet_grid(season ~ site, labeller = labeller(.cols =  labels_dist, .rows = labels_seas)) +
  labs(
    x = "Site",
    y = "Flight Initiation Distance (m)",
    fill = "Size"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10), 
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom') +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'OrRd',
                    labels = c("Small", "Medium", "Large"))


OR5_raw_size
```

```{r SAVE Online Resource 5: FID vs size for each couple site-season (data RAW)}

  geom_boxplot(data= FID_vsm_data, aes(x = size, y = FIDi, fill = size), 
               width = 0.7, linewidth = 1, outlier.size = 2) +
  facet_grid(season ~ site, labeller = labeller(.cols =  labels_dist, .rows = labels_seas)) +

    fill = "Size"
  ) +

    strip.text = element_text(size = 20)
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom') +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'OrRd',
                    labels = c("Small", "Medium", "Large"))
```
